item: How long Serum 2 needs after a state load before MultiSample audio is ready, and the proof of the default wait (serum-render 0.7.1)

method.render: one fresh process and plugin instance per render, EngineHost.render, 44100 Hz; equal means bit-identical float32 audio

stimuli.sweep: MIDI, notes 24 to 96 at velocity 127 then 40, one every 20 ms

method.worker_counts: 7 is the default (cpu_count - 1), 8 the most the GUI offers on this machine; the CLI sets no cap
method.presets_over_16_MiB: one big render to workers - 1 renders of PN - Piano Space, since one child needs up to 3.5 GB; other presets run in bursts of themselves
method.machine_state: each burst records load average, swap, and CPU and memory of processes outside the run. A burst is discarded if those averaged 6 cores or more, or grew 500 MB while swap grew. Runs started after a gate: load under 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, swap not grown between two checks 10 minutes apart
method.not_covered: Every run had the sample files in the OS file cache after the first load; a cold cache was not measured. One machine only.

choice.reason: the longest ladder wait that failed was 3 s (7 of 8) and the shortest that always passed for every preset was 5 s; 10 s is twice that
